channel.title: Global Arbitration Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Arbitration Review (globalarbitrationreview.com)

item.title: German court confirms set-aside of AstraZeneca award
item.description: Germany’s top court has upheld the annulment of a US$46.4 million German Arbitration Institute (DIS) award against AstraZeneca – but rejected the pharmaceutical group’s attempt to block the dispute from being remitted to the tribunal.

item.title: HKIAC award in satellite dispute enforced in California
item.description: A satellite investor that is accused of being a proxy for the Chinese government has successfully enforced an HKIAC award in California, with a court rejecting arguments that the arbitration was skewed by Hong Kong’s national security law.

item.title: Atlanta-headquartered firm promotes two
item.description: Atlanta-headquartered Smith Gambrell & Russell has named Christopher Smith and Daniel Goldstein as partners in the disputes team it launched two years ago.

item.title: BVI court refuses to enforce award annulled in Cairo
item.description: A court in the British Virgin Islands has refused a bid by a Saudi medical investor to enforce a CRCICA award worth US$23 million after it was set aside by the courts at the seat of the arbitration in Egypt.

item.title: Argentina fails to set aside customs inspection award
item.description: A Dutch court has rejected Argentina’s bid to set aside a US$165 million investment treaty award won by a subsidiary of Kuwaiti logistics group Agility over a contract to provide customs inspection services, 17 years after the investor first submitted an arbitral claim.

item.title: French court upholds Derains award despite corruption probe
item.description: The French Court of Cassation has affirmed that a pending judicial investigation of French arbitrator Yves Derains for alleged corruption is not a valid basis to set aside an award in an unrelated ICC arbitration in which he was tribunal president.

item.title: Spain challenges UK solar investor’s second award
item.description: Spain has asked ICSID to annul a €260 million award won by a British investment fund in a resubmitted Energy Charter Treaty case over reforms to the state's renewable energy subsidy regime.

item.title: Emirati real estate investors take on Egypt
item.description: An Emirati businessman and companies linked to him have filed an ICSID claim against Egypt over two large real estate development projects.

item.title: Russia fails in latest challenge to Wintershall tribunal
item.description: Russia has failed in its third challenge to tribunal members in Wintershall Dea’s Energy Charter Treaty arbitration against the state, after accusing the entire panel of bias and disregard for due process when it issued a procedural order seeking to move the case along and denying a request for assistance with a sanctions-related matter.

item.title: Ghana brings maritime boundary claim against Togo
item.description: Ghana has said it will seek international arbitration under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea to delimit its maritime boundary with its West African neighbour Togo.
